status.scope_reason: The company builds and sells Eximbills Enterprise, which is an end-to-end processing software platform for traditional trade finance and supply chain finance.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website, China Systems remains an active provider of trade finance software, announcing that its flagship product Eximbills Enterprise went live at City Bank PLC in July 2025.

claims.claim: The company reports that its software architecture natively embeds advanced product features such as unlimited multi-currency reporting, parameter-driven configurations, automated compliance processing, and full alignment with SWIFT, UCP, and ISO 20022 messaging standards.
claims.source: China Systems Corporation Product Pages (https://chinasystems.com and https://chinasystems.com)

claims.claim: The company reports that its native trade and supply chain compliance solution automates screening for individuals, countries, dual-use goods, and vessel information, featuring an out-of-the-box integration with Accuity's Compliance Link for Trade Finance.
claims.source: China Systems Compliance Solution Page & Finextra Press Release (https://chinasystems.com and https://finextra.com)

claims.claim: The company completed a full integration in October 2022 with partner technology provider Traydstream to embed automated machine learning-based document checking, digitisation, and validation against 250,000+ trade and compliance rules directly into the Eximbills Enterprise banking architecture.
claims.note: The detail regarding validation against exactly "250,000+ trade and compliance rules directly into the Eximbills Enterprise banking architecture" as part of the full integration is unverified in official partnership press releases, although 250,000+ is a general capability statistic of Traydstream's standalone platform.

claims.claim: The company reports that its core trade finance platform, Eximbills Enterprise, maintains API integrations with major electronic bill of lading (eBL) and digital trade documentation networks, including established technical partnerships with Bolero, CargoX, and Enigio's trace:original.
claims.source: China Systems Partner and Strategic Alliances Profile & Press Room (https://www.chinasystems.com/partners/industry-partners-and-alliances and https://chinasystems.com)

claims.claim: Independent verification from SWIFT confirms that the company achieved four SWIFT Compatible Application Labels for 2026 covering Trade Finance, Payments, Trade Finance for Corporates, and SWIFTgpi, ensuring native alignment with SWIFT MT7xx standards.
claims.source: China Systems Press Release & SWIFT Application Profile 2026 (https://chinasystems.com and https://swift.com)

claims.claim: In February 2025, the company completed a deployment of a cloud-based supply chain financing solution leveraging Eximbills Microservices in collaboration with Nedbank CIB.

The company reports integrating its back-office engine with an optical character recognition (OCR) and artificial intelligence (AI) engine for real-time document checking, document classification, and machine-learning-driven rule execution to fully automate letter of credit processing workflows.
claims.note: OCR and AI integration details for complete automation of letter of credit processing workflows

claims.claim: The company launched a Trade Digitalisation Services (TDS) unit to consult and run integration projects with trade finance fintech partners, including working with Enigio to integrate its trace:original blockchain-based digital document flow into China Systems' Eximbills Enterprise back-office platform.

China Systems announced the successful launch of Bank Mandiri's upgraded Kopra Trade digital portal in February 2026, which uses the vendor's front-end solution to manage trade finance and bank guarantee transactions.
City Bank PLC went live on China Systems' Eximbills Enterprise and Customer Enterprise solutions in July 2025 to digitally transform its paper-based trade finance processing in Bangladesh.
The company reports serving more than 150 bank customers worldwide, with its flagship trade finance back-office application, Eximbills, deployed in over 75 countries.
An independent historical review noted that Eximbills was utilized by more than 200 customers across over 600 installations globally.

status.scope_reason: The company develops and provides a multi-bank supply chain finance and working capital platform that connects financial institutions and businesses.
status.evidence: Startup Nation Finder confirms that Efficient Finance is an active fintech company based in Tel Aviv providing a multi-bank supply-chain finance platform.

claims.claim: The company reports the availability of its EF Financial Cloud Platform, which acts as a rules-based and AI-driven ERP extension allowing financial providers to integrate and offer just-in-time financing.
claims.source: Efficient Finance Official Website (https://efficientfinance.com and https://efficientfinance.com)

claims.claim: The company holds historical underlying patents for its transaction systems, including US Patent US8396790B2 titled "System and method for financing commercial transactions," originally filed in December 2002.
The company reports that its proprietary IT platform runs thousands of transactions automatically each year to finance billions of dollars with clients globally.
The company reports maintaining an office location at Alon Tower II, 94 Yigal Alon St. in Tel Aviv, Israel.
The company reports providing supply chain finance solutions to clients globally over an online platform intended to eliminate the dependency on local bank branch presence.
claims.source: Startup Nation Central Finder & Careers Profile (https://devjobs.co.il)

claims.claim: The company reports that its proprietary platform runs thousands of transactions each year and has financed billions of dollars with clients globally across multiple industries according to the Efficient Finance Corporate Profile.
